text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing by the training 
course—

Daiwa Scarlet had come to a halt on the 
track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No... I just popped a blister. I can 
easily handle this much.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you got a band-aid or 
something on you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I haven't run anywhere near enough yet, so 
I've gotta do something about this.
choice_data_list: Shall I tape it up for you?

Let's head to the infirmary just to be 
safe!

Let's head to the infirmary just to be 
safe!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I haven't run anywhere near enough yet, so 
I've gotta do something about this.
choice_data_list: Shall I tape it up for you?

Let's head to the infirmary just to be 
safe!

Let's head to the infirmary just to be 
safe!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds lovely. How thoughtful of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take you up on that. Make 
sure to tape it up good and tight, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Looks like I can run with this, 
thanks. A little pain is... well, par for 
the course.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I told you I'm fine, didn't I? Honestly. 
You're exaggerating so much.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, well... treating it properly should 
make running afterward much safer...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh* Alright, fine. I'll go get it 
checked out.
